specs.description: GLINTBLADE The Long Quiet. Authentic 1x native pixel art game environment prop, clean readable planar clusters, restrained melancholy monumental abandoned water infrastructure. Low top-down three-quarter RPG view, front facing south, vertical architecture rises straight upward. Light upper-left. Crisp opaque native pixels or transparency, no antialias, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow painted under sprite, no floating disconnected rubble, no decorative outlines, no cyan, no glow, no FX, no text. Complete solid feet with generous transparent margin on all sides. ONE wide broken chalk aqueduct landmark. Three purposeful narrow water conduit arches, left tall surviving distributor tower 85px high, broad elevated empty water trough traveling right, middle arch has generous empty opening, far-right span snapped off exposing its U-shaped conduit, two clearly separated masonry pier FEET both on same horizontal baseline. Large quiet ash-mauve shadow face, chalk left plane, sparse dusty sage growth only in two seam clusters. Ruin silhouette reads as a water-carrying machine, immense garden infrastructure rather than generic castle wall. Base width about140px, height95px.
